title: Teach AI to Say I Don't Know
headings: **From Slow AI #8 – Teach It to Use Less**
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: If you’re new here, *Slow AI* is a weekly series of gentle prompts
The aim is not speed or productivity. It’s to slow down, to ask different questions, and to let AI help us notice what we might otherwise miss.
